extName.description: Extension name shown in chrome://extensions and Chrome Web Store. DO NOT TRANSLATE — proper noun, must remain identical in all locales.

extDescription.message: Unified chat history hub for ChatGPT / Claude / Gemini / GoogleAI / Grok / Grok on X.
extDescription.description: Extension short description in manifest.json (max 132 bytes UTF-8). Service brand names (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GoogleAI, Grok) are proper nouns — DO NOT TRANSLATE.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip shown on hover over the toolbar action icon. DO NOT TRANSLATE — proper noun.

actionSync.description: Header button label that triggers the sync flow.

actionDelete.description: Header button label that opens the delete-services dialog.

actionCancel.description: Generic cancel button label used in dialogs.

actionCopyUrl.description: Tooltip and aria-label for the row-level URL copy button.

actionFavorite.description: Tooltip and aria-label for the row-level favorite (♥) toggle.

a11yMenu.description: Aria-label and tooltip for the ⋯ menu summary button.

a11yDateRangeFilter.description: Aria-label for the date range group inside the filter section.

a11yServiceFilter.description: Aria-label for the service chips group.

a11yServiceFilterChatgpt.description: Aria-label for the ChatGPT chip. ChatGPT is a proper noun.

a11yServiceFilterClaude.description: Aria-label for the Claude chip. Claude is a proper noun.

a11yServiceFilterGemini.description: Aria-label for the Gemini chip. Gemini is a proper noun.

a11yServiceFilterGoogleai.description: Aria-label for the GoogleAI chip. GoogleAI is a proper noun.

a11yServiceFilterGrok.description: Aria-label for the Grok chip. Grok is a proper noun.

a11yServiceFilterXgrok.description: Aria-label for the X-Grok chip (Grok feature embedded in X.com).

a11yDatePresetAll.description: Aria-label for the date preset chip that selects all dates.

a11yDatePreset7d.description: Aria-label for the 7-day date preset chip.

a11yDatePreset30d.description: Aria-label for the 30-day date preset chip.

a11ySortToggle.description: Aria-label for the sort direction button.

a11yScrollTop.description: Aria-label and tooltip for the floating scroll-to-top button shown when the list is scrolled down.

chipWithCount.description: Service chip label with a count badge. ja uses no space (`All(15)`); en uses a space before the parenthesis (`All (15)`).

filterDatePresetAll.description: Date range preset chip for showing all dates.

filterDatePreset7d.description: Date range preset chip for the past 7 days.

filterDatePreset30d.description: Date range preset chip for the past 30 days.

filterSearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and aria-label for the title search input.

filterSortDesc.description: Sort direction button label (descending = newest first).

filterSortAsc.description: Sort direction button label (ascending = oldest first).

accountAllWithCount.description: Account select option label with a count badge.

menuExportJson.description: Menu item that exports all records as a JSON file.

menuExportCsv.description: Menu item that exports all records as a CSV file.

menuImportJson.description: Menu item that imports records from a JSON file.

emptyNoHistoryTitle.description: Empty-state title shown when no records exist in IndexedDB.

emptyNoHistoryHint.message: Click the "Sync" button at the top to fetch your history.
emptyNoHistoryHint.description: Empty-state hint suggesting the user runs sync.

emptyFilteredTitle.description: Empty-state title shown when filters exclude all records.

emptyFilteredHint.description: Empty-state hint suggesting the user adjust filters.

dialogMismatchTitle.description: Title of the account-mismatch warning dialog.

dialogMismatchTargetLabel.description: Prefix label before the target account email in the mismatch dialog body. Includes trailing space.

dialogMismatchCopyUrl.description: Button label that copies the conversation URL to clipboard.

dialogMismatchOpenAnyway.description: Button label that opens the conversation in current browser despite mismatch.

dialogSyncTitle.description: Title of the sync-services selection dialog.

dialogSyncConfirm.description: Confirm button label inside the sync dialog.

dialogDeleteTitle.description: Title of the delete-services selection dialog. The (irreversible) suffix is intentional.

dialogDeleteConfirm.description: Confirm button label inside the delete dialog.

dialogSelectionAll.description: Checkbox label for the All option in sync/delete dialogs.

serviceXgrok.description: Display name for the Grok feature embedded in X.com. Use proper noun for the rest (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/GoogleAI/Grok).

commonUntitled.description: Fallback label for records without a title (rec.title is empty).

badgeMismatch.description: Row badge shown when the record's accountEmail differs from the current Chrome profile.

statusLoginRequired.description: Status label for the not_logged_in error code.

statusNetworkError.description: Status label for the network_error code (fetch TypeError).

statusTabUnreachable.description: Status label for the tab_unreachable code (no matching tab found).

statusContentUnreachable.description: Status label for the content_unreachable code (content script not injected; reload tab).

statusAccountUnknown.description: Status label for account_email_not_found / screenname_not_found codes.

statusDomChanged.description: Status label for pfp_not_found / userid_not_found / history_container_not_found / profile_link_not_found codes.

statusInvalidOrg.description: Status label for the invalid_org_entry code (Claude organization parsing failed).

statusInvalidShape.description: Status label for the unexpected_response_shape code.

statusSessionFailed.description: Status label for the session_retrieval_failed code (Gemini).

statusConvFetchFailed.description: Status label for the conversations_retrieval_failed code (X-Grok).

statusGenericError.description: Status label for unrecognized error codes.

statusErrorUnknown.description: Fallback used when an error string is missing.

syncing.description: Sync button text during a sync flow (with spinner).

syncBtnTotalCount.description: Sync button text after a multi-service sync completes.

syncBtnSingleCount.description: Sync button text after a single-service sync completes.

syncBtnFailed.description: Sync button text when all services fail.

statusSyncRowOk.description: Per-service sync success row in the status bar.

statusSyncFailed.description: Status bar message when the entire sync flow throws.

syncActionGemini.message: Open it in a tab and re-sync
syncActionGemini.description: Action button label that opens gemini.google.com and asks the user to retry. Service name omitted to fit narrow side-panel width; the adjacent service-row label identifies which service this action targets.

syncActionGoogleai.message: Open it in a tab and re-sync
syncActionGoogleai.description: Action button label that opens google.com/search?udm=50 and asks the user to retry. Service name omitted to fit narrow side-panel width; the adjacent service-row label identifies which service this action targets.

syncActionGrok.message: Open it in a tab and re-sync
syncActionGrok.description: Action button label that opens grok.com and asks the user to retry. Service name omitted to fit narrow side-panel width; the adjacent service-row label identifies which service this action targets.

syncActionXgrok.message: Open it in a tab and re-sync
syncActionXgrok.description: Action button label that opens x.com/i/grok/history and asks the user to retry. Service name omitted to fit narrow side-panel width; the adjacent service-row label identifies which service this action targets.

deleteSvcCount.description: Per-service breakdown entry inside the delete-success status bar message.

statusDeleteOk.description: Status bar message after successful delete.

statusDeleteEmpty.description: Breakdown placeholder when no records were deleted.

statusDeleteFailed.description: Status bar message after a delete error from SW.

statusDeleteFailedConsole.description: Status bar message when the delete flow throws.

toastFavoriteFailed.description: Status bar message when toggling favorite fails to write to IndexedDB.

toastExportJsonOk.description: Status bar message after a successful JSON export.

toastExportCsvOk.description: Status bar message after a successful CSV export.

toastExportFailed.description: Status bar message when the export flow throws.

toastImportFilePickFailed.description: Status bar message when the OS file picker fails.

toastImportCanceled.description: Status bar message when the user cancels the import.

toastImportInvalidJson.description: Status bar message for the invalid_json error code.

toastImportNotArray.description: Status bar message for the not_an_array error code.

toastImportGenericFailed.description: Status bar message for unknown import errors.

toastImportDbReadFailed.description: Status bar message when readAll() throws during import.

toastImportMergeFailed.description: Status bar message when mergeRecords throws during import.

toastImportDbWriteFailed.description: Status bar message when upsert() throws during import.

toastImportOk.description: Status bar message after a successful import.

importConfirmBody.message:
Import preview:
  New: $CREATED$
  Updated: $UPDATED$
  Unchanged: $UNCHANGED$
  Invalid: $INVALID$

* Records sharing the same service / accountEmail / conversationId
  are overwritten with the newer updatedAt.
* Favorite (♥) is overwritten only if the JSON has it.

Apply changes?
importConfirmBody.description: Multi-line confirm() text shown before applying an import. Use \n for line breaks. Numbers are filled from $CREATED$/$UPDATED$/$UNCHANGED$/$INVALID$.
